context: Two teens compare new hobbies they want to try
purpose: Teach: うっかり/おもい/おなか/つづく/とれる/はじめる/はたして/ましてや

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、わたし最近ドラムをはじめるか迷ってるんだよね。
lines.en: Hey, lately I've been wondering whether to start drums.
lines.style: Sakura speaks with bright curious teenage energy, casual and slightly excited.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ドラム!?めっちゃ意外、うっかり聞き逃すとこだった。
lines.en: Drums!? Super unexpected, I almost carelessly missed hearing that.
lines.style: Riku reacts with surprised laid-back teen tone, mildly teasing his friend.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でしょ?でもセットがおもいって聞いて、はたして続けられるか不安なんだ。
lines.en: Right? But I hear the sets are heavy, wondering if I can really keep at it.
lines.style: Sakura sounds doubtful and reflective, voicing teenage self-questioning honestly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 俺はね、乗馬はじめようかなって。こないだ馬場見に行ったら馬がマジでかわいかった。
lines.en: Me, I'm thinking of starting horseback riding. I went to see the arena and the horses were seriously cute.
lines.style: Riku speaks warmly and a bit dreamily, gentle teen enthusiasm about animals.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ええっ、乗馬って高くない?ましてや習い事って続けるのお金かかるじゃん。
lines.en: Whaat, isn't riding expensive? Much less lessons, keeping them up costs money.
lines.style: Sakura turns practical and skeptical, teen voice sharpening with realistic concern.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: だからエビフライ屋でバイトはじめるつもり。まかない付きでおなかも満たされる神シフト。
lines.en: That's why I'll start a part-time at the fried-shrimp shop. Meals included, stomach gets filled, godly shift.
lines.style: Riku grins through his words, casual proud teen sharing a clever plan.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 天才じゃん!じゃあ私もバイトしてレッスン代とれるか相談してみよっかな。
lines.en: You're a genius! Then maybe I'll work too and see if I can pull together lesson money.
lines.style: Sakura laughs lightly, playful envious teenage banter with a teasing lilt.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいじゃん、ストレス発散にもなるしさ。この話、放課後カフェでつづくの楽しみだわ。
lines.en: Nice, it'll be stress relief too. Let's continue this convo at the cafe after school.
lines.style: Riku encourages her with sincere supportive teen warmth, leaning into friendship.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: りょ!作戦会議ね。ローズティーの店、新しくできたとこ行こ!
lines.en: Got it! Strategy meeting then. Let's go to that new rose tea place that just opened!
lines.style: Sakura responds with animated giggly teen energy closing warmly and excitedly.
